description: Golden vectors for verifiable channel membership (channel.proto 'Verifiable Membership'). Keys are deterministic test keys (private = SHA-256("chatter-membership-vector-key:" || name)). Enum fields are protobuf numbers. A change is verified against prev_state ("" = empty pre-genesis state) for channel_id; when ok, the resulting state must hash to expect_state's hash. Signatures are randomised XEdDSA: verify, never compare bytes.
